{{Quote|Though the Alliance had countless cells on thousands of planets, a single command headquarters was necessary for the Rebel leadership to rest and plan strategy. The first of these top-secret bases was established on a tiny planetoid in the Chrellis system, though the HQ was designed for continual relocation.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC" />}}
The '''Chrellis system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]]. It contained the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Chrellis]], the site of the first [[Chrellis Base|base]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command]]. At one point, an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] also hosted an independent community of [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2 repair droids]].

==Description==
The Chrellis system was located in the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the tiny [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Chrellis]]<ref name="NEC" /> and at least one [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="CSWE G2" />

==History==
At some point, in what became a notorious incident, a team of [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2 repair droids]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] a [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and established their own community on the Chrellis [[Star system/Legends|system's]] asteroid.<ref name="CSWE G2" /> Following the [[Corellian Treaty|foundation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="NEC" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the first [[Chrellis Base|base]] of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] was established on the planetoid<ref name="NEC" /> under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="NEGTC" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] reallocated its [[Sector fleet/Legends|sector fleets]], the base on Chrellis became uncomfortably close to [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] activity and was moved to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]<ref name="AoR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|93|Briggia}}</ref> [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]].<ref name="AoR" /> The fact that the Chrellis system hosted the first Alliance High Command base was eventually recorded in a [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The Essential Chronology|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> as well as its [[36 ABY]] [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|updated edition]] by the Council's incarnation under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chrellis system was first mentioned in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Paul Murphy]] and published in [[1990]] for use with [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square M-5.<ref name="TEA" />
